title: One entry in the operator configuration change history
description: Source: the append-only box_settings_audit table (migration 013), projected by src/box/repository.ts. BOTH the configured AND the effective value are recorded before and after, because a deployment ceiling can make those differ and 'I set 150,000' versus '120,000 was enforced' is exactly the distinction an incident review needs. `config_version` links the entry to the configuration snapshot it produced. NO CREDENTIAL IS EVER RECORDED: `actor_role` is an operator ROLE ('full' | 'trade'), never a token, passcode or session identifier, and only settings classified as plain `config` are registrable at all. CLOSED so an added field is caught.

actor_role.description: The operator ROLE that made the change. Never a token, passcode or session identifier.

setting_key.description: The camelCase domain key, not the environment variable name.

previous_effective_value.description: What the engine was ENFORCING before the change — not necessarily the previously configured value, because a deployment ceiling may have been clamping it.

mutation_policy.description: The policy under which the change was admitted, so the trail explains WHY it was allowed in the state the system was in.

new_source.description: Provenance of the effective value after the change, so a deployment clamp is visible in the trail rather than inferred.

session_id.description: The armed trading session at the time of the change, when there was one.

config_version.description: The configuration version this change produced.
